sources.verified_claim: Current NPB+ player information separately lists Sprint Speed (スプリントスピード) and fastest time to first base (最速タイム（一塁到達）) as batter tracking fields.
sources.provenance_guard: This confirms current source availability only. It does not validate historical local npb_plus_measurement.hp_to_1b_sec values previously classified MISATTRIBUTED_SOURCE.
sources.next_action: Recollect exact current per-player H2F from the official NPB+ surface with value-level provenance; keep the old contaminated local field excluded until independently reconciled.

sources.source: MLB Statcast 90-foot Running Splits glossary / Baseball Savant leaderboard
sources.verified_claim: Statcast breaks qualifying home-to-first runs into cumulative five-foot increments through a standardized 90-foot time; the leaderboard exposes raw split times and percentile rankings. A 2017 leaderboard is currently accessible in addition to current seasons.
sources.construct_role: initial acceleration shape plus standardized end-to-end running context; distinct from Sprint Speed
sources.bias_guard: The glossary notes raw home-to-first geometry differs by batting side and defines a standardized 90-foot extrapolation. Do not equate raw contact-to-first and standardized 90-foot time without preserving that distinction.
sources.next_action: Inventory available seasons and eligible NPB/MLB crosswalk players; collect split vectors and derive predeclared acceleration-shape features with player-clustered validation.

sources.source: Baseball Savant Statcast Outfielder Jump leaderboard
sources.verified_claim: Outfielder Jump is exposed with separate Reaction, Burst, and Route components; historical player pages also expose annual component values.
sources.construct_role: defensive-context burst/acceleration proxy for eligible outfielders only
sources.bias_guard: Use Burst separately. Do not collapse Reaction or Route into physical running speed, and do not generalize an outfielder-only context metric to all players without validation.
sources.next_action: Measure MLB-experienced outfielder coverage and same-player relation to Sprint Speed / 90-foot acceleration before deciding whether Burst adds independent information.

sources.verified_claim: 1.02 defines Spd (Speed Score) as a 0-10 index averaging four components: stolen-base success rate, stolen-base attempt frequency, triple rate, and scoring frequency.
sources.construct_role: mixed outcome proxy, not direct physical speed
sources.double_count_guard: The formula overlaps with stolen-base and triple/outcome lanes already present in the project. Any use must test incremental information and avoid counting the same outcomes twice.
sources.next_action: Inventory historical/current availability and test conditional incremental validity against independent physical evidence. Reject or downweight if it adds no information beyond its component proxies.

sources.source: MLB Statcast Lead Distance glossary / Basestealing Run Value leaderboard
sources.verified_claim: Statcast separately measures Lead Distance, and the basestealing leaderboard exposes Lead Distance Gained between the pitcher's first move and pitch release.
sources.construct_role: stealing/start/lead technique context useful to deconfound stolen-base outcomes from physical running speed
sources.bias_guard: Lead distance is not physical speed. Its value is primarily in explaining why steal outcomes or steal times differ at similar physical speed.
sources.next_action: For MLB-experienced players, test whether lead/start variables explain stolen-base outcome residuals after physical speed; use them to separate technique rather than raise base speed directly.

sources.source: MLB Statcast Baserunning Run Value glossary / Baseball Savant leaderboard
sources.verified_claim: Statcast Baserunning Run Value evaluates stealing and/or extra-base decisions using opportunity-level context including runner speed, fielder arm and positioning; current leaderboard documentation exposes the combined outcome-value concept.
sources.construct_role: opportunity-adjusted baserunning/technique context, not pure physical speed
sources.double_count_guard: The metric itself uses runner speed as an input and overlaps with steal/advance outcomes. It must not be treated as independent physical ground truth or double-counted with Sprint Speed and advancement outcomes.
sources.next_action: Inventory eligible MLB coverage and test only for technique/context or residual information after direct physical speed, with explicit source-version definition because glossary/leaderboard formulations may differ by baserunning component.
